bio.text: According to the New Jersey Globe in June 2026, Aristotle Eliopoulos is a teachers union official and a registered Republican who filed to run as an independent for New Jersey's 8th Congressional District.
The Globe reported that local Republican leaders, whose party did not file its own candidate in the district, were supporting him; the incumbent is Democratic Rep. Rob Menendez.

sources.title: Husband-and-wife duo from Tennessee will run as pro-life independents for competitive N.J. seats
